recentItems.title: Ex-BARMM lawmaker, 10 others tagged in PH-bound 521-kg shabu shipment in Laos
recentItems.description:
A former member of the Bangsamoro Parliament is among the persons of interest in the 521-kilogram shabu shipment bound for the Philippines and intercepted in Laos earlier this month, Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said on Friday (October 16).

Former BARMM parliament member Sultan Edrieza Nasser Rimbang is the financier of the chartered flight that would have carried the shabu haul to Manila, Remulla said in a Palace press conference. — Report from Katrina Domingo, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: Faithful send good wishes as Pope Leo continues his recovery following surgery | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
Patients and healthcare staff at Rome's Gemelli Hospital sent their best wishes for a speedy recovery to Pope Leo on Friday (October 16), as he continued treatment for lung cancer following surgery.

The Pope's recovery from the operation was going as planned, and the 71-year-old pontiff had resumed some work activities, the Vatican said on Thursday (October 15).

Visitors to the hospital welcomed the news, noting that Leo was "in great shape" and hoping to see him again soon in St Peter's Square.

The Pope has been diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, the most common form of lung cancer, and doctors removed the lower lobe of his right lung during an operation on Tuesday (October 13).

Leo's public engagements have been cancelled until next Tuesday (October 20). His pathology report, which will be key to deciding what further treatment he may require, may not be available for several days. — Reuters



(Camera: Claudia Chieppa; Production: Matteo Negri, Writing: Joshua McElwee, Editing: Matteo Negri)
